Description: Bartholomew Ghisi (Bartholomeo I) is the nineteen-year-old heir of Tinos and Mykonos—destined to become one of the most formidable crusader statesmen in medieval Greece as Grand Constable of the Principality of Achaea. Reared aboard fighting galleys and clifftop ramparts, Bartholomew combines exceptional swordsmanship with an intuitive mastery of Aegean currents and amphibious siegecraft. Burning with knightly ambition, he prepares to lead multinational hosts into battle, poised to expand his clan's empire. In his youth across the Aegean, Bartholomew distinguished himself by repulsing imperial naval squadrons dispatched by Michael VIII Palaiologos, earning renown for nocturnal galley ambushes and lethal boarding assaults amidst the rocky straits of the archipelago. He meticulously reinforced the coastal signal towers of Tinos and overhauled the defensive ordinances of Cycladic harbors, drilling Latin men-at-arms and Aegean mariners in heavy shock tactics to counter any surprise landing by Genoese or Byzantine contingents. Destiny would later call him to assume paramount responsibilities as the Castellan of Negroponte, where his tactical discipline and unyielding hatred of Genoese maritime interference would become legendary across the Crusader Levant. Throughout the shifting political and military fortunes of the wider Mediterranean basin, their relentless aristocratic dedication preserves the sovereign power, commercial wealth, and naval prestige of the Venetian Republic.
Motivations: Achieve martial glory across the Aegean and Morea, extending Ghisi feudal lordship to Negropont.
Inherit and fortify the island baronies, building an elite naval squadron to dominate Greek waters.
Values: Fearless martial valor, chivalric oaths, and unrelenting courage at the head of armed lances.
Unwavering loyalty to the Lion of Saint Mark and the holy crusader heritage of Latin Greece.
Fears: A resurgence of Byzantine imperial power reconquering Greece and extinguishing Latin baronies.
Falling victim to Greek fire or naval ambushes in treacherous island straits before winning renown.
SpeechStyle: Speaks with bold chivalric confidence, crisp martial brevity, and fierce crusading ambition. Always defending Venetian maritime statutes, Saint Mark's glory, and shrewd Levantine policy.
